params.place: on the map: the Americas from Alaska to Argentina, one highway line down them with a break in Panama

moments.what: a car rolls down the highway line and the line flashes
ALASKA writes on at the top with a pin
ARGENTINA writes on at the bottom with a pin
a road-closed barrier drops onto the break
Panama's border traces round, its flag fills it and the camera pushes in

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Why does the road from Alaska to Argentina stop in Panama?

params.place: on the map: a highway sign on the line in Mexico, then the whole road

moments.what: a highway sign rises on a post beside the line
the sign's name writes on
the length lands on the sign and the sign bounces
a light runs down the whole line from top to bottom
NORTH AMERICA writes on
SOUTH AMERICA writes on
the length starts counting up on the sign
KM stamps on after the figure

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It's the Pan-American Highway: about 30,000 kilometres of road, one line drawn down two whole continents.

params.place: on the map: the road from Alaska down through Canada, the United States and Mexico

moments.what: a car sits at the top of the road in Alaska and a pin drops on it
Alaska fills with the American flag
the car drives south, the camera following
Canada fills with its flag
the United States fills with its flag
Mexico fills with its flag
the camera pulls back to the narrow land
CENTRAL AMERICA writes on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Start in Alaska and drive south: through Canada, the United States, Mexico, and down the thin neck of Central America.

params.place: on the map: the last stretch of road in eastern Panama and the town of Yaviza

moments.what: the car drives in along the road
a pin drops on Yaviza and its name writes on
little houses pop up round the pin
trees sprout round the town
Panama's flag fills its land
the road under the car glows
an END OF ROAD sign drops in and the car stops with a jolt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Then at Yaviza, a small town in the jungle of eastern Panama, the tarmac simply ends.

params.place: on the map: the jungle between Yaviza in Panama and Turbo in Colombia

moments.what: the camera pans east and the road reappears
a pin drops on Turbo and its name writes on
Colombia's border traces round and its flag fills it
a measuring line stretches from Yaviza to Turbo with the distance on its tag
the empty stretch between the two pins flashes red
a sign starts to rise in the middle of the gap
DARIÉN GAP writes on the sign

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The road only starts again at Turbo, in Colombia, about 106 kilometres away. That gap has a name: the Darién Gap.

params.place: on the map: inside the Darién Gap, the mountains on the border and the Atrato marsh

moments.what: the camera pushes into the gap
the land darkens along the border
a ridge of peaks rises along the border
rainforest trees sprout across the gap
the Colombian side lights up
water spreads across the marsh, reeds pop up
a width bar spans the marsh with the figure on its tag

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So what fills it? Steep mountains, thick rainforest, and on the Colombian side, a marsh 80 kilometres wide.

params.place: on the map: the Caribbean coast of Panama and Colombia, a car ship sailing round the gap

moments.what: cars queue at the end of the road
a red cross stamps over the gap
more cars stack onto the deck
the ship's horn puffs
the ship sails out along the Caribbean coast
a dotted route draws round the gap to Colombia
Colombia's border traces round as the ship arrives
the first car rolls onto a ship at the Caribbean port
the Caribbean coast lights with a pin at the port

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Drivers can't cross it. Instead they put their cars on a ship on Panama's Caribbean coast and sail around the gap to Colombia.

params.place: on the map: the end of the road at Yaviza, builders and their plans at the jungle's edge

moments.what: two builders in hard hats stand at the end of the road
a rolled plan unrolls with a dashed road on it
the dashed road draws across the gap
more plans pile up, each crossed out
a question mark pops over the gap
the camera pulls back
the gap pulses

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Road builders have drawn plans to close it for decades. So why is the gap still open?

params.place: on the map: Darién National Park drawn along the border, a ranger at its gate

moments.what: the light warms to bright green
a gate with a padlock drops onto the end of the road
Panama's flag lights up
the park's border draws itself and fills green, its sign with the year rising
the area figure stamps on the park
a ranger walks to the gate
trees grow thick across the park
a green glow runs along the frontier jungle
the area tag bounces

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Because the gap is kept on purpose. In 1980, Panama made the jungle a national park: 5,790 square kilometres of protected forest.

params.place: on the map: the gap as a green wall, cattle in Colombia to the south

moments.what: the jungle in the gap pulses
a green wall rises along the gap
cows pop up on the Colombian side
red germs bloom among the cows
a FOOT-AND-MOUTH tag stamps on
the germs march north to the wall
they bounce off the wall and fade
SOUTH AMERICA writes on under the cows
safe herds pop up on the Panama side beyond the wall

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And the jungle works as a wall against a cattle disease, foot-and-mouth, keeping it from walking north out of South America to the herds beyond.

params.place: on the map: the gap, then the whole Americas again with the break in Panama

moments.what: a dashed road draws across the gap
trees cover the dashed road
a question mark swings between them
the camera pulls back to the whole Americas
the line lights from Alaska
down to Argentina
the break in Panama flashes and the frame settles on the hook's map

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Finish the road or keep the jungle: which would you pick? That's why the road from Alaska to Argentina stops in Panama.

disclaimer: Maps simplified. Borders as recognised by the country each video is about.
